quotes.speaker: Tolu Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Tolu Smith is switching to shooting free throws left-handed this season.
quotes.excerpt: I am naturally a lefty. I write with my left hand
quotes.quote: We switched it up a little bit so it is a nice thing. It has been working for me. I think it is something I will stick with. Conversations with Freddy V. I am naturally a lefty. I write with my left hand, I throw a football with my left so it was just a matter of time I think.
quotes.social_post: Tolu Smith says he is switching to shooting free throws left-handed this season, noting that he is naturally a lefty and it was just a matter of time.

quotes.speaker: Tolu Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Tolu Smith credits Paul Reed for mentoring him during training camp.
quotes.excerpt: Me and B-Ball we are always in the gym.
quotes.quote: Me and B-Ball we are always in the gym. He is always talking to me, telling me things. You know he has been in the league for a little bit now so I always get me little gems and hitting tips to stay ready. Little things that little nuances that he has that allows him to stay ready.
quotes.social_post: Tolu Smith says he and Paul Reed are always in the gym together, and that Reed has been providing him with tips and nuances to help him stay ready.
